completeness.failure: Omission is INVALID_TEST_EXECUTION; a mapper may neither add unsupported normative evidence nor silently subtract native normative evidence.
completeness.rule: Every native emitted normative field must appear in the normalized normative observation set unless an explicitly frozen exclusion rule names that field.

DIRECT.rule: Normalized value must equal the value at source_field in the native emitted observation identified by source_observation_id.

rule: If a normative field cannot be directly and mechanically traced to the native emitted observation, it is inadmissible to normative predicates.
runtime_validation: Every normative wrapped value must use a permitted transform.
source_observation_id must resolve to exactly one native event.
source_field must resolve in that native event.
normalized value must equal the resolved native source value exactly.
For DIRECT normalization, normalized field path must equal source_field.
Diagnostic/derived values cannot satisfy normative predicates.
Normalized normative field paths must completely cover native emitted normative field paths, excluding only explicitly frozen diagnostic-only exclusions.
